ValidationRule.description: Only Event campaigns are mapped geographically, so the event location fields must stay empty for every other type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Event")), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Venue__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Street__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_City__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_State__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Postal_Code__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Event_Country__c, "")), NOT(ISBLANK(Location_Event__Latitude__s)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Event location fields can only be used when the campaign Type is Event. Clear them or change the Type to Event.
